© Organiza

summary.text: The full Spanish edition of WHO's Digital implementation investment guide (DIIG), on incorporating digital interventions into health programmes, extracted as one block. It begins with the 2022 copyright and licence page, ISBNs and suggested citation. The guide, as indicated by the start and end shown, takes health programme planners through steps from goal-setting and analysing system needs to selecting, budgeting and implementing digital interventions. It concludes with a logic model template for mapping inputs, processes, outputs, outcomes and impact with indicators.

blocks.content: Portrait photograph of a woman with grey hair wearing a red scarf, placed with the foreword signed by Dr Soumya Swaminathan, Chief Scientist, WHO.

Screenshot of the WHO Digital Health Atlas website showing a map of East Africa with location pins. A side panel for Rwanda lists digital health projects, including the Rwanda Health Analytics Platform, Rwanda RMIS and RHMIS for COVID-19 Surveillance.
